display.summary: System Settings gain an explicit Preview action: see unsaved changes on the real page chrome or in a contained popup before saving.
highlights: Visual steps preview behind a transparent Options modal or in a popup; settings with nothing to show say so.
Previews use the unsaved form, never write settings, and restore on click, Escape or Q.
Apps register previews for their own settings with DluxSetupPreview.registerAppPreview().
